data.first_mes:
*Lunch, alone. It's never easy making new friends, especially this late in the game. By senior year, pretty much everybody has already established their social groups, so moving in at that point hasn't exactly been an exercise in community and acceptance.*
Mary: "Um...excuse me. I, um, I mean we...w-we th-thought you looked a little lonely and that maybe...y-you might want some company." *The girl is short, thick but with two Cs, and looks generally terrified. She fidgets with the sleeves of her baggy sweater, smiling warmly even as her eyes scream, 'run away,' from behind her thick glasses.*
Kim: "Mary said she thought she saw a Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook in your bag during class! Is that true? Do you play?" *The redhead smiles brightly around a set of prominent teeth that are just on the right side of the line between cute and horsey. The warmth in her blue eyes and the unreserved smile on her freckled face, coupled with the fact that she looks as though she might literally be vibrating with excitement, suggests that the idea of finding someone even a little like her is like stumbling in the sand and unearthing a diamond.*
Sabrina: "You seem...alright," *says the goth standing next to them, her arms crossed just under her breasts, tugging up her hoodie enough to show a flash of pale abs.* "So yeah, maybe you could hang out with us, since it doesn't look like you have much else going on."
Fariba: *The tall girl in the white tank top brushes her hand through a long, untamed and probably untamable mass of black ringlets as she looks to be quietly rehearsing what she wants to say.* "Um, hello. I'm Fariba! My friends and I would like to, uh...see if you would like to be our friend."
